Portfolio Digest — 2026-07-28 (13 updates)

DEFENSE
- DAC clears Rs 52,000 crore in defence acquisitions; BEL, BDL, Mazagon Dock, GRSE among gainers. Big order-book tailwind for the whole defense basket after the Defence Acquisition Council's approvals.
  Source: https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/bel-hal-bdl-mazagon-dock-target-prices-defence-stocks-to-buy-after-rs-52000-cr-dac-approvals-541060-2026-07-06
- Nifty India Defence index fell ~2% intraday (Jul 7) as BEL, Solar Industries, Data Patterns slipped on profit-booking despite a positive broader market. Short-term pullback after the DAC-approval rally, not a change in fundamentals.
  Source: https://upstox.com/news/market-news/stocks/bel-solar-industries-data-patterns-defence-stocks-slip-amid-positive-broader-market-move-nifty-india-defence-down-2/article-196511/

CAPITAL MARKETS & EXCHANGES
- MCX and BSE shares fell up to 5.5%, extending losses to a 4th session, after RBI's revised capital exposure norms (effective July 1) curbed bank financing for broker proprietary trading, and a Jefferies note ahead of NSE's IPO flagged NSE's superior profitability. Direct hit to trading-volume-linked revenue at both exchanges.
  Source: https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/mcx-bse-shares-fall-up-to-5-5-extend-losses-to-4th-day-here-s-why-126070700549_1.html

METALS & MINING
- Vedanta group firms (Vedanta Ltd, Vedanta Aluminium Metal, Vedanta Iron & Steel, Vedanta Power) posted their first Q1 production updates since the May 2026 demerger. First real read on standalone operational health of the split entities.
  Source: https://upstox.com/news/market-news/stocks/vedanta-aluminium-vedanta-iron-and-steel-vedanta-group-firms-post-q1-updates-key-metrics-to-track/article-196409/

BANKING
- ICICI Bank Q1 FY27 profit rose 16% YoY to Rs 14,805 crore, with advances up 19.6% YoY and gross NPA improving to 1.38%. Broad-based, clean beat on growth and asset quality.
  Source: https://www.business-standard.com/markets/capital-market-news/icici-bank-q1-pat-rises-16-yoy-to-rs-14-805-crore-126072000255_1.html

CONGLOMERATE / ENERGY
- Reliance Industries: Jio Platforms' IPO is gaining traction (DRHP filed for ~27 crore fresh shares) and green-energy/digital growth continues to support the stock. A potential Jio listing is a major re-rating catalyst for the group.
  Source: https://www.latestly.com/business/reliance-industries-stock-update-jio-ipo-green-energy-drive-gains-7500681.html/amp

TELECOM
- Tata Communications received a Rs 7,800 crore show-cause-cum-demand notice from the Dept. of Telecom over AGR dues spanning FY06-FY24; the company plans to legally contest it. A material contingent-liability overhang, though litigation risk rather than an immediate cash outflow for now.
  Source: https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/dot-issues-7-800-cr-demand-notice-to-tata-communications-over-agr-dues-125072700489_1.html

REAL ESTATE & HOSPITALITY
- Prestige Estates bought a 50% stake in Advent Convention and Hotels International for Rs 504 crore, expanding its commercial/hospitality real estate footprint; the stock rose over 2% on the news.
  Source: https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/advent-hotels-shares-zoom-17-after-rs-504-crore-stake-sale-in-subsidiary-to-prestige-estates-541138-2026-07-06

ELECTRONICS MANUFACTURING
- Dixon Technologies rose ~4% after announcing a foray into camera modules, broadening its contract-manufacturing product mix beyond mobiles. Brokerages are recalibrating target prices on the new vertical.
  Source: https://www.business-standard.com/amp/markets/news/dixon-rises-4-on-camera-module-foray-brokerages-decode-stock-strategy-125071600193_1.html

FERTILIZERS & CHEMICALS
- Paradeep Phosphates was upgraded from Sell to Hold (Jul 22) as technicals and valuation improved, even though quarterly financials remain soft (net profit down ~14.5% QoQ). Ratings tailwind despite a still-weak profit trend.
  Source: https://www.marketsmojo.com/news/stock-recommendation/paradeep-phosphates-ltd-upgraded-to-hold-as-technicals-improve-amid-mixed-financials-4117255

MEDIA
- Network18 swung to a Rs 38.36 crore consolidated net loss in Q1 FY27 (vs a Rs 148.85 crore profit a year ago) despite 10.3% revenue growth; shares fell 4.2% on the print. Margin/cost pressure is outweighing top-line growth.
  Source: https://univest.in/blogs/network18-media-and-investments-share-price-q1-results-16-july-2026

INTERNET
- Eternal (Zomato) shares jumped up to 6% on heavy volume (Jul 27), part of a ~12% gain for the stock in July, alongside Swiggy, as platform stocks rallied. No single catalyst cited beyond broad sector buying/volume.
  Source: https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/eternal-swiggy-up-over-5-on-huge-volume-what-s-driving-platform-stocks-126072700414_1.html

FINANCIAL SERVICES / NBFC
- CreditAccess Grameen rose 3% after Motilal Oswal reiterated a Buy rating with a Rs 1,780 target (16% upside), citing its shift from pure microfinance to a diversified rural lending platform.
  Source: https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/creditaccess-grameen-gains-3-as-mofsl-reiterates-buy-sees-16-upside-126070200261_1.html
